materials_exhausted.note: Primary XML/PDF/OA package and linked database rows were sufficient to recover Tables 1-3 and adjudicate database conflicts. Supplementary ZIP contains a PDF with modeling tables and dose-response curves but no additional structured activity endpoint table beyond the main article tables.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains a separate layer; raw XML/PDF/OA package/supplement/database snapshots were reopened rather than trusted from summaries.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural validator readiness is treated as necessary but not sufficient; worker-6 reran strict semantic and publication gates after owner-layer repair.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 matched primary-source table values and sequence/modification evidence where available while preserving unsupported database category/target-label conflicts as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 resolved the multi-row headers in Tables 1-3 and recorded endpoint, value, unit, target, assay context, and locators without fabricating values for ND or inequality rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 separated direct FRET Mpro inhibition, computational binding support, and phenotypic antiviral activity; cell EC50 rows are not overpromoted to direct mechanism proof.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking or major issue remains after source review; remaining issues are explicit cautions and no open rework target remains.

caution_findings.finding: Linked DRAMP/CAMP/dbAMP rows contain over-broad antimicrobial labels, unsupported influenza function text, SARS-CoV-19 typo labels, or one VZV threshold mismatch; these are retained as source_conflict rather than hidden.
Supplementary Figure S16 dose-response curves were checked with pdftotext; endpoint values used for curation are the source-tabulated main-text values, not graph digitizations.
FRET assay supports partial Mpro enzymatic inhibition and modeling supports binding context, but cellular antiviral EC50 values are preserved as phenotypic activity evidence.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 source re-review recovered Tables 1-3 into source-located activity/toxicity rows, preserved database conflicts, adjudicated mechanism evidence boundaries, and closed the targeted ticket with cautions.
summary: Tables 1-3 are now source-reviewed into row-level activity/toxicity evidence; database conflicts remain visible cautions and the paper is publication-grade with cautions.
